seeds.sg-3-2-0-0: Among the leaning spire-ribs, you balance across a singing glass girder while a salt-gale tests your footing and your haste.
seeds.sg-3-2-0-1: In a courtyard of cracked prisms, a scavenging tinker trades stale water for a sliver of your lantern-fuel before you can pass.
seeds.sg-3-2-1-0: Beneath a canopy of melted lenses, an old mirror-sentry named Vane warns you that the upper viaducts hum with dangerous resonance.
seeds.sg-3-2-1-1: Within a hollow crystal dome, you navigate a maze of razor-sharp shards while distant signal-flashes blink warnings you cannot parse.
seeds.sg-3-2-1-2: Across a chasm of fused green glass, a rusted pulley-crane offers a perilous swing toward the lower industrial terraces.
seeds.sg-3-2-1-3: Because your debts are clear, a hospitable lens-grinder gifts you an intact optic lens that reveals hidden footholds in the glowing dust.
seeds.sg-3-2-1-4: Beside a dry obsidian fountain, a salt-crusted trader tries to block your path with tales of a collapsing archway ahead.
seeds.sg-3-2-1-5: Inside a ruined conservatory of singing crystal, chiming wind-wires threaten to trip your steps and draw unwanted attention.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-0: Through a tunnel of cobalt glass, you crawl past the nested nests of glass-eaters whose glittering shells mimic the pavement.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-1: On a suspended terrace of amber mosaic, a broken mirror-post flashes erratic signals that blind your progress.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-2: Within a hollowed statue of an Old Lensfolk queen, you squeeze through a narrow joint to bypass a toll-lord checkpoint.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-3: Across a shimmering floor of white salt-crust, your boots crunch loudly while unseen watchers whisper from the hollow towers.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-4: Beneath a shattered solar arch, a discarded miner cart provides a rolling bridge over a treacherous trench of broken crystal.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-5: Because your ember-lamp burns steady, its warm orange glow catches a hidden vein of soft lead solder framing a secret crawlway.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-6: Inside a tilting gallery of concave panes, your distorted reflection misleads your sense of balance and direction.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-7: Upon a balcony of fused quartz, a nervous scavenger drops a bag of grinding sand right into your path.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-8: Through the ribcage of an ancient glass-dome, you scramble upward while sharp shards threaten to slice your heavy travel pack.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-9: Beside a dry cascade of violet crystals, an abandoned mirror-frame acts as a sun-trap that bakes the air into shimmering ripples.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-10: Within a hollow pillar of stacked spectacles, a trapped desert gecko startles you as it skitters across your cold ceramic key.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-11: Across a slender bridge of spun glass-wool, you tread lightly to avoid tearing the delicate ancient webbing.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-12: Underneath a vaulted ceiling of smoky quartz, a smoky draft carries the sulfurous stench of old glass-kilns.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-13: In a courtyard filled with hollow glass bells, every footstep rings out like a crystalline chime across the silent basin.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-14: Beside a towering monolith of magnifying glass, focused sunbeams scorch the salt crust inches from your boots.
seeds.sg-3-2-2-15: Through a sunken cellar of preserved optic fluid, you wade ankle-deep through heavy, viscous oil that smells of stale rosemary.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-0: On a crumbling parapet of sea-green glass, you dodge a falling icicle of fused quartz that shatters at your heels.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-1: Within a grand amphitheatre of whispering echoes, phantom voices mock your urgency and obscure the real path.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-2: Across a network of rusted iron chains strung between glass spires, you inch forward like a tightrope walker.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-3: Beneath a canopy of hanging prisms, a sudden flare of distant mirror-signals forces you to duck into a dark alcove.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-4: Inside a workshop filled with frozen mercury vats, metallic fumes make your head swim as you search for an exit.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-5: Upon a slope of granular salt and tiny glass beads, your boots slip backward with every exhausting stride upward.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-6: Through a warped doorway of melted borosilicate, you enter a chamber where the walls pulse with trapped twilight.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-7: Beside a fractured obelisk of ruby glass, a discarded water skin lies empty and taunting in the dry heat.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-8: Within a multi-tiered balcony of shattered mirrors, you dodge dancing sun-hares that dazzle your tired eyes.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-9: Across a deep trench filled with jagged glass teeth, a fallen girder offers a narrow, trembling lane of safety.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-10: Under a low ceiling of heavy leaded panes, you crawl on hands and knees while sharp edges scrape your wool coat.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-11: In a plaza of singing wind-harps, vibrating strings create a low subsonic drone that rattles your teeth in your skull.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-12: Beside a bubbling pool of superheated brine, steam hisses against the cold base of your ceramic seedkey.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-13: Because Pell guides your steps, you bypass the unstable cantilevered streets and slip safely through an old drainage flue.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-14: Through a gallery of distorted portrait-mirrors, grotesque reflections of your tired face stretch into towering spectres.
seeds.sg-3-2-3-15: On a ledge of iridescent mother-of-pearl glass, a flock of copper-winged desert birds takes flight and startles your pace.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-0: Approaching the outer boundary of the shard maze, you face a sheer wall of fused window-panes stretching toward the hazy sky.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-1: At a junction of three glass-walled alleys, a dying signal-lamp casts long, weaving shadows that hide the correct trail.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-2: Climbing a spiralling ramp of translucent slag, you watch the vast salt flats spread out endlessly below your feet.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-3: Crossing a high sky-bridge of ribbed crystal, you feel the structure hum ominously beneath the rising wind of the approaching storm.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-4: Navigating a subterranean conduit of green glass tiles, you follow the cool draft that whispers of the open basin edge.
seeds.sg-3-2-5-0: Pausing on the final terrace of the Shard Cities, you spot the looming mass of Prism rising beyond the shimmering salt horizon.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-5: Ducking beneath a sagging arch of lead and glass, you dodge a cascade of loose crystal beads tumbling from above.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-6: Weaving through a forest of hollow quartz pillars, you ignore the haunting musical notes your passage draws from the tubes.
seeds.sg-3-2-4-7: Emerging onto a grand plaza of white salt and broken lenses, you ready your lamp against the gathering shadows of the mirror storm.
seeds.sg-3-2-5-1: Skirting the edge of a great glass-crater, you catch your breath as the first electric flashes of the mirror storm lick the southern sky.
seeds.sg-3-2-5-2: Vaulting over a low barricade of salvage crates, you leave the labyrinth of broken towers behind for the final approach to the observatory.
seeds.sg-3-2-5-3: Standing at the precipice of the last glass ridge, you plunge your hand into your coat to feel the cold, reassuring weight of the Seedkey as the mirror storm breaks.
seeds.sg-d-3-2: Ignoring all caution, you sprint across an unstable bridge of singing glass that shatters completely beneath your boots, plunging you into a bottomless trench of sharp shards.
